scripts.build: npm run generate:theme && npm run generate:playbooks && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.test: npm run generate:playbooks && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && tsx --test src/*.test.ts server/*.test.ts && npm run test:browser
scripts.dev: npm run generate:theme && npm run generate:playbooks && vite --host 127.0.0.1
